--- PART 1/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE

RESOLUTION: kept using the report / "We need produce new strategy. We can analyze PD payoffs" / "The parent fitness 251.6. Top in population slot 8 fitness 261.26" / "We need new strategy improving parent."
STRATEGY: Parent slot 7 is mostly cooperative, retaliates D after opponent D, defects only if opponent has enough defections. The trace simulates the parent and population slots against classic opponents (Always C, Always D, TFT, Random) and analyzes exploitable forgiving strategies. It proposes a new adaptive strategy that starts C, tests with an early defection, exploits forgiving opponents, and apologizes/returns to C if the opponent retaliates.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "So a strategy: - Start with C. - At round 3, defect once (test)."
STRATEGY: The parent is a hand-designed adaptive strategy that starts with C, defects once at round 3 as a test, apologizes with C if the opponent retaliates, and otherwise increases defection frequency against forgiving opponents. The trace simulates this against the listed population slots (0, 1, 4, 9, 11, etc.) and computes payoffs. It was changed into a state-machine rule using history-derived counts of punishments, last defect index, and since_last to decide when defection is allowed.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The parent score is 251.6. The top is 261.3. We want to beat that. Our strategy should aim for >261.3."
STRATEGY: Parent is a mostly-cooperating TFT-like policy that never defects unless the opponent defects. The trace simulates the revised adaptive strategy against the 12 population slots (Always C, Always D, forgiving/strict TFT variants, slot 0, slot 4, slot 11) and pure cooperators. It changes the base defection interval, punishment thresholds, forgiveness rules, and adds an endgame defection when the opponent has never defected.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Overall, this strategy is a significant improvement over parent."
STRATEGY: Parent is a conditional cooperator/retaliator with punishment counting and scheduled defections. The trace simulates it against pure C, TFT, Always D, Random, and a two-early-defection opponent. It adds an endgame defection rule and chronic-defector rule, then outputs the revised code.
